texts.NIV84: A wise son heeds his father's instruction, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
texts.KJV: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
texts.NKJV:
A wise son heeds his father’s instruction,
But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
texts.DRB: A wise son heareth the doctrine of his father: but he that is a scorner, beareth not when he is reproved.

texts.NIV84: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful have a craving for violence.
texts.KJV: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
texts.NKJV:
A man shall eat well by the fruit of his mouth,
But the soul of the unfaithful feeds on violence.
texts.DRB: Of the fruit of his own mouth shall a man be filled with good things: but the soul of transgressors is wicked.

texts.NIV84: He who guards his lips guards his life, but he who speaks rashly will come to ruin.
texts.KJV: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
texts.NKJV:
He who guards his mouth preserves his life,
But he who opens wide his lips shall have destruction.
texts.DRB: He that keepeth his mouth, keepeth his soul: but he that hath no guard on his speech shall meet with evils.

texts.NIV84: The sluggard craves and gets nothing, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.
texts.KJV: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
texts.NKJV:
The soul of a lazy man desires, and has nothing;
But the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.
texts.DRB: The sluggard willeth and willeth not: but the soul of them that work, shall be made fat.

texts.NIV84: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
texts.KJV: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
texts.NKJV:
A righteous man hates lying,
But a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.
texts.DRB: The just shall hate a lying word: but the wicked confoundeth, and shall be confounded.

texts.NIV84: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
texts.KJV: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
texts.NKJV:
Righteousness guards him whose way is blameless,
But wickedness overthrows the sinner.
texts.DRB: Justice keepeth the way of the innocent: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

texts.NIV84: One man pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
texts.KJV: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
texts.NKJV:
There is one who makes himself rich, yet has nothing;
And one who makes himself poor, yet has great riches.
texts.DRB: One is as it were rich, when he hath nothing: and another is as it were poor, when he hath great riches.

texts.NIV84: A man's riches may ransom his life, but a poor man hears no threat.
texts.KJV: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
texts.NKJV:
The ransom of a man’s life is his riches,
But the poor does not hear rebuke.
texts.DRB: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but he that is poor beareth not reprehension.

texts.NIV84: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
texts.KJV: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
texts.NKJV:
The light of the righteous rejoices,
But the lamp of the wicked will be put out.
texts.DRB: The light of the just giveth joy: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

texts.NIV84: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.
texts.KJV: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
By pride comes nothing but strife,
But with the well-advised is wisdom.
texts.DRB: Among the proud there are always contentions: but they that do all things with counsel, are ruled by wisdom.

texts.NIV84: Dishonest money dwindles away, but he who gathers money little by little makes it grow.
texts.KJV: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
texts.NKJV:
Wealth gained by dishonesty will be diminished,
But he who gathers by labor will increase.
texts.DRB: Substance got in haste shall be diminished: but that which by little and little is gathered with the hand shall increase.

texts.NIV84: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.
texts.KJV: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
texts.NKJV:
Hope deferred makes the heart sick,
But when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.
texts.DRB: Hope that is deferred afflicteth the soul: desire when it cometh is a tree of life.

blocks.title: The Law of the Wise is a Fountain of Life

texts.NIV84: He who scorns instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command is rewarded.
texts.KJV: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
texts.NKJV:
He who despises the word will be destroyed,
But he who fears the commandment will be rewarded.
texts.DRB: Whosoever speaketh ill of any thing, bindeth himself for the time to come: but he that feareth the commandment, shall dwell in peace. Deceitful souls go astray in sins: the just are merciful, and shew mercy.

texts.NIV84: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
texts.KJV: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
texts.NKJV:
The law of the wise is a fountain of life,
To turn one away from the snares of death.
texts.DRB: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, that he may decline from the ruin of death.

texts.NIV84: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
texts.KJV: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
texts.NKJV:
Good understanding gains favor,
But the way of the unfaithful is hard.
texts.DRB: Good instruction shall give grace: in the way of scorners is a deep pit.

texts.NIV84: Every prudent man acts out of knowledge, but a fool exposes his folly.
texts.KJV: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
texts.NKJV:
Every prudent man acts with knowledge,
But a fool lays open his folly.
texts.DRB: The prudent man doth all things with counsel: but he that is a fool, layeth open his folly.

blocks.title: He Who Walks With Wise Men Will Be Wise

texts.NIV84: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.
texts.KJV: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
texts.NKJV:
A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
But a faithful ambassador brings health.
texts.DRB: The messenger of the wicked shall fall into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

texts.NIV84: He who ignores discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
texts.KJV: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
texts.NKJV:
Poverty and shame will come to him who disdains correction,
But he who regards a rebuke will be honored.
texts.DRB: Poverty and shame to him that refuseth instruction: but he that yieldeth to reproof, shall be glorified.

texts.NIV84: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
texts.KJV: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
texts.NKJV:
A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul,
But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
texts.DRB: The desire that is accomplished, delighteth the soul: fools hate them that flee from evil things.

texts.NIV84: He who walks with the wise grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
texts.KJV: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
texts.NKJV:
He who walks with wise men will be wise,
But the companion of fools will be destroyed.
texts.DRB: He that walketh with the wise, shall be wise: a friend of fools shall become like to them.

texts.NIV84: Misfortune pursues the sinner, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
texts.KJV: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
texts.NKJV:
Evil pursues sinners,
But to the righteous, good shall be repaid.
texts.DRB: 21Evil pursueth sinners: and to the just good shall be repaid.

blocks.title: A Good Man Leaves an Inheritance

texts.NIV84: A good man leaves an inheritance for his children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.
texts.KJV: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
texts.NKJV:
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children,
But the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the righteous.
texts.DRB: The good man leaveth heirs, sons, and grandsons: and the substance of the sinner is kept for the just.

texts.NIV84: A poor man's field may produce abundant food, but injustice sweeps it away.
texts.KJV: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
texts.NKJV:
Much food is in the fallow ground of the poor,
And for lack of justice there is waste.
texts.DRB: Much food is in the tillage of fathers: but for others it is gathered with out judgment.

texts.NIV84: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is careful to discipline him.
texts.KJV: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
texts.NKJV:
He who spares his rod hates his son,
But he who loves him disciplines him promptly.
texts.DRB: He that spareth the rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him correcteth him betimes.

texts.NIV84: The righteous eat to their hearts' content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.
texts.KJV: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul,
But the stomach of the wicked shall be in want.
texts.DRB: The just eateth and filleth his soul: but the belly of the wicked is never to be filled.
